plugin_installation: Codex-managed installed plugin location; discovered from the loaded package
active_release_pointer: installation.json with internally stamped version and release digests
active_release_update: stage under a bounded temporary root, self-test, then publish direct stable component roots before Windows registration
prior_release_policy: preserve an occupied prior installation for explicit user-owned cleanup; never merge layouts or infer ownership from PID
toolchain_scope: Every retained locally installable tool and transitive dependency in the complete registry, including required model assets and compatible provider environments
external_services: Install clients/adapters; keep remote service configuration and credentials explicit
release_input_policy: Exact sparse-root bytes from the installed Git ref plus SHA-256-bound component assets from the same repository release only; no third-party acquisition during first detection or operations
release_asset_partitioning: Deterministic regular-file parts with at most 1750000000 payload bytes each; every logical component requires one complete ordered part sequence
license_policy: Copy complete retained license/source evidence; Ghostscript remains explicit-license-gated
prewarming: One bounded shared worker pool loads installed dependencies as selected by lane/operation contracts; no per-project dependency installation
codex_direct_use: Explicit executable/environment paths resolved from this same installation and its verified receipt
macos: MCP/SDK/skills/hooks host path without local Studio or the Windows-managed toolchain
install_sequence: final explained purge and candidate qualification
first plugin detection provisions full shared Studio and toolchain installation
verify installed runtime and native connection
release_binding_status: RELEASE_BOUND; first detection additionally requires exact remote Git-ref and release-asset readback
